endpoints.purpose: Exchange merchant_id + merchant_key for a bearer token (code MAS2001, data.token)
endpoints.notes: Token goes in 'Authorization: UPAY <token>'. BDPayGate caches it ~10 min and retries once on 401/403. Bad-credential reply code is simulator-invented (MAE4001).

endpoints.purpose: Open a payment session; returns gateway_url (code MPIS2002)
endpoints.notes: Body: date, txn_id, invoice_id, amount, transaction_currency_code, redirect_url, merchant_id/name/code/country_code/city/category_code/mobile, additional_info. Duplicate txn_id -> DTP4003. Magic scenario marker SIM:<name> in invoice_id or txn_id.

endpoints.purpose: Authoritative payment status (code PS2005; 404 PNF4012 when unknown)
endpoints.notes: status: success | failed | expired | cancelled | pending; amount is a number.

endpoints.purpose: Refund one or more payments: [{txn_id, refund_amount}] (code MPR_200)
endpoints.notes: Response data.success_list / data.failed_list{txn_id:{en,bn}}. 'Your request is under process' = accepted, pending. Partial refund_amount is accepted by the simulator but unconfirmed upstream (BDPayGate sends full refunds only).

endpoints.purpose: Simulator-only mock Upay wallet page (number -> OTP -> PIN)
endpoints.notes: No official counterpart; the real page is Upay's gateway_url.

endpoints.purpose: Mock page step/button handler; ends with the browser redirect
endpoints.notes: Redirect appends status + invoice_id to redirect_url (unsigned; always confirm with single-payment-status).

endpoints.purpose: Simulator-only return hop for real-sandbox payments
endpoints.notes: PaySim confirms with Upay's single-payment-status, then forwards to the merchant redirect_url.

notes: Upay's official PGW API v4.1.0 document is not public; every path here comes from community integrations that cite it.
No server-to-server IPN is documented: the browser redirect is the only push signal, so the simulator records it as a live-feed event instead of POSTing a webhook.
Every path ends with '/'. Live access requires Upay to allow-list the server IP.
The live host pg.upaysystem.com comes from BDPayGate only (unconfirmed).
